subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should OpenClaw add another general sub-agent rubric to `buildAgentSystemPrompt`, or keep current main's Tooling, Messaging, Sub-Agent Delegation, child-prompt, and tool-description guidance as the canonical policy surfaces?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer prompt-policy direction: current main already has several guidance surfaces and supports configured nested spawning, so automation cannot choose whether to consolidate, drop, or intentionally change nested-spawn policy.

options.title: Consolidate Or Drop Guidance
options.body: Keep current-main surfaces canonical and fold only uniquely useful examples into them after a rebase.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If maintainers want no nested spawning, update runtime/config/docs/tests and child prompts together rather than changing only the parent prompt.

options.title: Accept A Separate Rubric
options.body: Maintain another model-facing guidance block and own the resulting drift risk across prompt surfaces.

recommendation.title: Consolidate Or Drop Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep current-main surfaces canonical and fold only uniquely useful examples into them after a rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the recent broad prompt-surface change that now owns the overlapping prompt and sub-agent guidance surfaces.
